name: SJF Bank A/S
summary: Established in 1825 and headquartered in Holbæk, Denmark, Sparekassen Sjælland-Fyn A/S operates as a savings bank, delivering a wide array of financial services and products to both individual and corporate clients. The institution's offerings include deposit accounts, various lending solutions such as mortgages, vehicle, and home loans, alongside overdraft facilities, and a selection of savings and pension schemes. Additionally, it provides asset management, investment opportunities, and insurance products, all accessible through its mobile and internet banking platforms. The company, previously known as Sparekassen Sjælland A/S, officially changed its name to Sparekassen Sjælland-Fyn A/S in May 2016.
